citation.footer: MUTCD § 6H.02 · Table 6B-1 · Advance warning sign spacing

advance.road_type_text: At 45 mph, the signs are spaced by MUTCD Table 6B-1's Rural row.
advance.spacing_text: Table 6B-1 spacing: A 500 ft (the distance from the transition or point of restriction to the first sign), B 500 ft (the distance between the first and second signs), C 500 ft (the distance between the second and third signs).

buffer.lookup_text: MUTCD Table 6B-2 sets 360 ft; the CDOT supplement sets no value at this speed.

spacing.buffer_count_text: Buffer: 360 ft / 90 ft max spacing -> 3 cones at 90.0 ft intervals (CDOT S-630-1 Sheet 2 General Note 18b: tangents along the buffer space)
spacing.downstream_count_text: Downstream taper: 50 ft at ~25 ft spacing -> 2 cones (MUTCD Sec 6B.08: 50-100 ft downstream taper); 24 tangent + 3 buffer + 2 downstream = 29 cones total
formula_text: Buffer, 360 ft (S-630-1 Sheet 2 Note 18b) = 3 cones at 90.0 ft
Downstream taper, 50 ft (MUTCD Sec 6B.08: 50-100 ft) = 2 cones at ~25 ft
Cones in all (24 tangent, 3 buffer, 2 downstream) = 29
spacing.in_taper_text: In the taper, devices are spaced 45 ft apart, the speed in feet at 45 mph (MUTCD Sec 6K.01).
spacing.on_tangent_text: Along the tangent, devices are spaced 90 ft apart, twice the speed in feet (MUTCD Sec 6K.01).
spacing.tangent_count_text: 2000 ft / 90 ft max spacing -> 24 cones at 87.0 ft intervals
spacing.taper_count_text: L/3 = 150 ft / 45 ft max spacing -> 5 drums at 37.5 ft intervals

taper.cdot_reference: CDOT S-630-1 Case 11 (right-shoulder closure on divided highway)
taper.formula_choice: At 45 mph, at or above the 45 mph threshold, the taper length is the offset width times the speed.
taper.source: MUTCD 11th Ed. Sec 6B.08, Table 6B-4 (taper length L). Shoulder closures use L/3 per Sec 6B.08 (Table 6B-3).
